question:
Choose the correct meaning of idiom:

**Hang fire**

options.text: Delay taking action or making a decision

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. "Delay taking action or making a decision".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Hang fire"** means to delay taking action or postponing making a decision. (कार्यवाही करने में देरी करना या निर्णय को स्थगित करना)
 
 
• **Example:** The company decided to hang fire on launching the new product until the market research was complete.
 
 
• **Explanation:** "Hang fire" originally referred to a misfire in firearms where the gunpowder ignited but the bullet took time to fire. Over time, it evolved into meaning a delay in action or decision-making. (हिंदी में: "हैंग फायर" का मूल रूप से मतलब आग्नेयास्त्रों में एक गड़बड़ी से था, जहां बारूद जलता था लेकिन गोली चलने में समय लगता था। बाद में, इसका मतलब कार्यवाही या निर्णय लेने में देरी से हो गया।)

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

__
 
• **Option 2: Create urgency** (तत्कालता पैदा करना): Refers to making something more pressing or important to act upon immediately.
 
 
• **Example:** The sudden deadline created urgency among the team to finish the project.
 

 
• **Option 3: Withdraw support** (समर्थन वापस लेना): Refers to stopping or removing help or backing from someone or something.
 
 
• **Example:** The investor decided to withdraw support from the startup due to poor performance.
 

 
• **Option 4: Complete a task early** (कार्य को जल्दी पूरा करना): Refers to finishing a given task or project before the expected time.
 
 
• **Example:** She completed the assignment early and had time to review it thoroughly.

The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. "To support another while accepting inferior status".
